note: `kind` is fixed at creation; the schema admits no change of it, so a kudos badge becomes a community badge only by vtc/badges/promote.
`shareableOutside` fixes the credential regime of every award already accepted and is not changed; retire the badge and make it again.
`image` names an upload by its digest only; the picture's bytes travel in vtc/badges/images/upload, never here.
`holdersVisibleTo` is a GroupAudience: `admins`, `groupMembers` or `members` — never the world; a badge's holders are never public (VTI-BDG-071).
Bare/unnamespaced ext key — SPEC §4.5.1 requires every immediate child of ext to be reverse-DNS namespaced.
